crossRefs.note: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.
For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.
The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.
Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
“But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?
Further, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he pondered, sought out, and set in…
How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard?…
And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the…
Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that…

translations.web: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
translations.bsb: There is an abundance of gold and rubies, but lips of knowledge are a rare treasure.
translations.kjv: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
translations.asv: There is gold, and abundance of rubies; But the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
